items.title: File Einspruch against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Die Frist von zwei Wochen beginnt mit dem Tag der Zustellung.
items.computation: This is a formal delivery (Postzustellungsurkunde, § 182 ZPO); the attached envelope copy shows the postal worker's note '23.11.2026' as the date of Zustellung (a Monday), so that date, not the deemed-delivery rules for ordinary mail, fixes the start of the period. For an Einspruch against a Bußgeldbescheid the period is two weeks after formal delivery (§ 67 OWiG, § 43 StPO). Under §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB the day of delivery itself is not counted, and a period stated in weeks ends on the day of the last week bearing the same name as the day of the event; i.e. two weeks after Monday 23.11.2026 is Monday 07.12.2026. 07.12.2026 is a Monday and not a public holiday in Niedersachsen, so no shift under § 43 Abs. 2 StPO is needed.

items.title: Pay the total fine (Geldbuße, fee and delivery costs)
items.quote: Der Gesamtbetrag ist zwei Wochen nach Eintritt der Rechtskraft zu zahlen.
items.computation: Rechtskraft (legal force) enters once the two-week Einspruch period has expired unused, i.e. the day after 07.12.2026, so on Tuesday 08.12.2026 (assuming no Einspruch is filed). Payment is due two weeks after that day; under §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB the day of entry into legal force itself is not counted and the period ends on the corresponding weekday two weeks later: Tuesday 22.12.2026. 22.12.2026 is a Tuesday and not a public holiday in Niedersachsen, so no shift under § 193 BGB is needed. This date only applies if no Einspruch is filed in time; filing an Einspruch by 07.12.2026 would prevent Rechtskraft and this payment obligation from arising on this schedule.

warnings: The payment deadline (22.12.2026) is calculated on the assumption that no Einspruch is filed in time; if an Einspruch is filed by 07.12.2026, the fine does not become legally final on that schedule and this payment date does not apply.
A handwritten note ('Jan.') appears on the delivery-envelope copy on page 2 with no explanation; its meaning could not be determined and should be checked against the original envelope if available.
